observations.claim: T01: if platform_device_register returns nonzero, stock init_module skips __platform_driver_probe and returns fixed -ENODEV; ftm_probe is not invoked on this registration-error path.

T02: stub __platform_driver_probe itself to return a negative error E after platform_device_register succeeds; expected init_module to propagate that API return E. This is an API-level propagation test, not a claim that ftm_probe callback error E is returned by the platform core.
T03: setup ambos retornam zero; esperado init_module retorna zero.
T04: setup nó compatível ausente; esperado continua para ioremap; não chama of_iomap nesse ramo.
T05: setup nó encontrado; of_iomap nulo; esperado grava nulo em .bss+0x10 e continua.
T06: setup ioremap_prot nulo; esperado retorna -12; não chama sysfs_create_group.

T07: after valid ioremap, assert sysfs_create_group receives x0 = pdev->dev.kobj (the embedded struct device/kobject at platform_device base + 0x10) and x1 = static attribute-group object .data+0x4e0. If the call returns E, ftm_probe returns E after the error printk; no module-side sysfs_remove_group call is observed.
T08: setup sysfs_create_group retorna zero; esperado ftm_probe retorna zero.
T09: setup map pointer nulo em show_efs_recovery; esperado retorna -14 sem snprintf.
T10: setup word +4 varia: 0, 1, INT_MAX, 0x80000000; esperado capturar texto %d newline e bytes retornados.
T11: setup map pointer nulo em store_efs_recovery; esperado retorna -14 sem sscanf/store.
T12: setup store válido: zero, um, negativo e count variado; esperado grava 0 se parseado zero senão 1; DSB SY; retorna count.
T13: setup store input vazio/malformado e sscanf sem conversão; esperado local zero causa store zero; retorno sscanf ignorado; retorna count.

T14: preserve the opaque callback dev value in x0 at the is_secboot_device call; vary the callee's 32-bit w0 return across signed boundaries; the caller copies w0 to w3, formats it with the stock %d\n format into a 4096-byte buffer, and propagates snprintf's byte count.

details.callee_argument: At entry to show_secboot_status, x0 is the opaque sysfs dev callback argument; no instruction changes x0 before the call at .text+0x64. Assert the same pointer value reaches is_secboot_device; do not invent its C prototype.
details.caller_dataflow: After the call, mov w3,w0 zero-extends the low 32 bits into the snprintf variadic argument register. The stock format is %d\n, buffer size is 0x1000, and the callback sign-extends snprintf result from w0.

observations.claim: T15: set the QSEE stub return to nonzero; assert call inputs smc_id=0x02000807, arginfo=2, args[0] selected by the .bss byte, args[1..9]=0, atomic=1; then expect error printk, zero composite status, formatted false predicate, and snprintf return propagation.

T16: for a zero QSEE return, vary ret[0] bits 30/31 and ret[1] low/high words. Assert diagnostic composite = (u32)ret[0] | ((u32)ret[1]<<32), with ret[1] high 32 bits discarded; output predicate is true exactly when both bits 30 and 31 of ret[0] low word are set and is independent of ret[1].
observations.locator: simlock .text+0x114..0x174; qseecom_scm_desc.ret layout in pinned header

observations.claim: T17: setup permission e cleanup com stubs; esperado permission formata zero; cleanup desregistra driver antes do device.

Integration case: platform_device_register succeeds and ftm_probe callback fails before binding. Per pinned __platform_driver_probe, when no device binds the API returns -ENODEV and unregisters the driver; init_module propagates -ENODEV. Track the still-registered platform device separately; this is a core-state assertion, not a harness claim of runtime UAF.

Vary the observed .bss byte at offset 0 between zero/nonzero. Assert QSEE args[0] is 0x30 when zero and 0x00058030 when nonzero; assert arginfo=2, remaining args zero, smc_id=0x02000807 and atomic=1 in both cases. Do not assign a semantic name to the flag.

Exercise both arm64_use_ng_mappings branches; assert ioremap_prot receives phys_addr=0x58000 and size=0x1000; when arm64_use_ng_mappings==0 assert prot=0x0068000000000713, and when nonzero assert prot=0x0068000000000f13.

For show callbacks, invoke the stock callback through the pinned sysfs envelope with a non-null PAGE_SIZE buffer; assert the stock 0x1000 snprintf bound, exact output bytes, and returned length. NULL callback pointers are excluded from functional equivalence because the core constructs the kobject/attribute and output buffer before dispatch.
observations.locator: sysfs/file.c:42-73; stock show assembly call sites use size 0x1000

observations.claim: For store_efs_recovery, exercise valid kernfs buffers with counts 0, 1, and PAGE_SIZE and both parse/no-parse strings. Assert the buffer is NUL-terminated by kernfs, the observed 0/1 state normalization and DSB SY ordering, and the callback returns count. Do not pass arbitrary unterminated or NULL buffers as valid sysfs inputs.

test_scope_policy.valid_sysfs_show_inputs: Pinned sysfs core supplies kobj, attribute private data, and a buffer of at least PAGE_SIZE; the stock callbacks pass size 0x1000 to snprintf.
test_scope_policy.valid_sysfs_store_inputs: Pinned kernfs clamps non-atomic writes to PAGE_SIZE, copies into a kernel buffer, appends NUL, and serializes ops for one open file; test count boundaries 0, 1, PAGE_SIZE with valid terminated buffers.
test_scope_policy.null_pointer_policy: NULL kobj/attribute/buffer values are not valid callback invocations from this core path. Exclude NULL injection from the functional oracle; if used as robustness probes, report separately and do not infer supported behavior.
test_scope_policy.global_concurrency_limit: The per-open-file kernfs mutex does not prove serialization of the module-global EFS state across distinct attributes/open files; that remains MP5/L4.
